data.body:
[P2] Make cached names independent of traversal depth

`resolveOperation` depends on the current `inProgress.size`, but its result is cached solely by operation ID. With 16 nested contexts around a failed step, resolving the outer context first caches the depth-limited `StepError` for the innermost context. Its own record then reports `StepError` despite having a direct child reporting `PaymentError`. Resolving inner contexts first produces different results. Make memoization depth-aware so truncated lookups cannot become canonical operation names, and test all operations through one resolver in different iteration orders.
